_comment: Tier-2 for febio::fluid_fsi#0. <Module type="fluid"/> with <solver type="fluid-FSI"> and a `fluid-FSI` material gives 'tag "solver" (line N) : invalid value for attribute "type"' with 'Reading file ...FAILED!' — module-scoped solver factory, checked before the materials.
